## Summary
- add bounded retry/backoff around Sepo site deploy OIDC token fetches and deploy API POSTs
- validate that the Sepo deploy response includes a non-empty http(s) URL before publishing outputs
- restrict manual canonical site deploy workflow runs to the main branch while preserving AGENT_ENABLED gating

## Validation
- actionlint .github/workflows/agent-deploy-site-main.yml .github/workflows/agent-site-preview.yml
- ruby -e 'require "yaml"; ARGV.each { |f| YAML.load_file(f); puts "ok #{f}" }' .github/actions/deploy-sepo-site/action.yml .github/workflows/agent-deploy-site-main.yml .github/workflows/agent-site-preview.yml
- npx prettier .github/actions/deploy-sepo-site/action.yml .github/workflows/agent-deploy-site-main.yml --check
- cd .agent && npm ci && npm test

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: 02662faff8b6c19f53041222f7211e25374ad28f -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #37 hardens the Sepo site deploy path after the follow-up items from PR #36. It adds bounded retry handling around OIDC token fetches and Sepo deploy POSTs, validates that successful deploy responses include an `http(s)` URL, and gates manual canonical deploy runs to `refs/heads/main`. The PR is intentionally narrow, touching the shared deploy composite action and the canonical main deploy workflow. Current checks show the main `check` job passing, with deploy-related jobs skipped.

## Review
The PR addresses the main #36 hardening goals and keeps the change set surgical. There are no BLOCKING findings, but reviewers identified two concrete reliability/output-safety gaps that are still supported by the current diff.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Deploy URL validation accepts multiline output values | WARNING | The new URL check only verifies an `http(s)` prefix before writing the raw value to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT`, so a newline-bearing URL string can create extra output lines. |
| OIDC retry loop retries deterministic HTTP failures | WARNING | The OIDC fetch uses `curl --fail`, so auth/permission 4xx failures are retried like transient network or 5xx failures instead of failing terminally. |
| Per-attempt request timeouts are still implicit | INFO | The retry loops bound attempt count, but a stalled `curl` can still wait on curl/job defaults because no `--max-time` is set. |

## Progress
- The privileged canonical workflow now preserves `AGENT_ENABLED` and requires `github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`.
- Sepo deploy POST retries are now bounded and status-classified for `000`, timeout/rate-limit/server-like statuses.
- Successful deploy responses now require an `http(s)` URL before publishing outputs, though the value still needs single-line/output-safe validation.
- Existing inline comments and review threads were empty before cleanup. I posted one new inline comment on `.github/actions/deploy-sepo-site/action.yml` line 80 and did not reply to, minimize, or resolve any existing comments.
- Reviewers differed on OIDC retry severity: Rubrics called the 4xx retry behavior a warning, while Claude considered the asymmetry acceptable but worth documenting.

## Issue Details
<details>
<summary>Deploy URL validation accepts multiline output values</summary>

**Cause:** [`action.yml#L80`](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-template/blob/02662faff8b6c19f53041222f7211e25374ad28f/.github/actions/deploy-sepo-site/action.yml#L80) uses `test("^https?://")`, which accepts strings such as `https://example.test\nextra=value`; line 84 then writes that raw value to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT`.

**Candidate solutions:** Require a full single-line absolute URL before assignment, for example by rejecting whitespace/control characters or by parsing the value with a stricter URL validator before writing `url=$URL`.

**Comments:** This was posted inline because it is concrete, changed-line-specific, and not already covered by existing PR feedback.

</details>

<details>
<summary>OIDC retry loop retries deterministic HTTP failures</summary>

**Cause:** [`action.yml#L46-L55`](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-template/blob/02662faff8b6c19f53041222f7211e25374ad28f/.github/actions/deploy-sepo-site/action.yml#L46-L55) uses `curl --fail`, which collapses all HTTP failures into a generic nonzero exit path.

**Candidate solutions:** Capture the OIDC HTTP status with `-o`/`-w '%{http_code}'`, retry only likely transient statuses and network failures, and fail fast for deterministic 4xx responses.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Per-attempt request timeouts are still implicit</summary>

**Cause:** The OIDC and deploy POST `curl` calls have retry counts but no explicit `--max-time`, so a hung request can consume much more than the intended retry window.

**Candidate solutions:** Add a modest per-attempt timeout consistent with the repo’s existing OIDC broker patterns, while preserving the current three-attempt retry budget.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: The remaining warnings are concrete, scoped branch changes in the shared deploy action and are safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

## Action Items
- [ ] Tighten deploy response URL validation so only a single-line, output-safe absolute `http(s)` URL is written to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT`.
- [ ] Classify OIDC HTTP failures before retrying so deterministic auth/permission 4xx responses fail terminally.
